name: PFAS-free oil repellent
problem: PFAS bans hit fabric finishes, and fluorine-free ones don't repel oil
design: Fluorine-free repellent finish that repels oil as well as water

market.what: textile water/oil repellent finishes (C6 fluorocarbon + fluorine-free: wax, silicone, dendrimer, PU, acrylic), world
market.method: F-free $580M (QYResearch 2024) + fluorinated est. ~$0.5B; bottom-up: 68 kt F-free x ~$8.5/kg = $0.58B + est. ~50 kt C6 x ~$10/kg = $0.5B; China list prices F-free $5-15/kg, C6 $10-15/kg; reports range $0.74B (Valuates 2023) to $2.2B (FMI 2025)

value.logic: est.: ~$0.5B/yr C6 finish spend on fabrics that need oil/chemical repellency has no PFAS-free fix (F-free = AATCC 118 grade 0); keeps oil-repellent goods sellable (chem-splash PPE $1.57B 2024, workwear, military, upholstery, car seats) ~ +$0.5B; total ~$1B
value.revenue_logic: 2 kt/yr (~4% of est. 50 kt C6 volume) x $15/kg (C6 price level + small premium), sold via toll maker or chem partner
value.margin_logic: specialty emulsion at C6 price on cheap acrylate/siloxane raw materials; toll-made

trend.drivers: PFAS bans: CA AB 1817 (2025, 50 ppm TOF 2027, severe-wet outdoor 2028), NY 2025, Maine 2026, France clothing 2026 / all textiles 2030, EU PFHxA REACH, EU universal PFAS restriction pending
trend.deadline: EU PFHxA limit: consumer clothing 10 Oct 2026, other textiles Oct 2027

competition.notes: Strongest: AGC + DRYFIBER, first non-fluorinated oil/water repellent, launch 2026 (no grade published); Matregenix claims AATCC 118 grade 2; GTT $6M Series C Nov 2024; H&B $2.4M pre-seed (water only); Toronto 'fletched' PDMS still uses CF3 (PFAS); Fashion for Good DW(O)R-X benchmark 2026 (adidas, C&A, SGS)

lab.synth: polymer: 1-2 step custom low-surface-energy monomer (branched alkyl/siloxane side chain) x3 variants, then emulsion comb copolymer; durability needs a polymer, not a small molecule
lab.test: pad-dry-cure on PES + cotton; AATCC 22 spray, AATCC 118 oil (target grade >=4; F-free today = 0), AATCC 193 water/alcohol, AATCC 130 soil release, after 0/10/20 AATCC 135 washes; Hohenstein, SGS, Intertek or NC State Textiles
lab.logic: monomers 6 wk + polymerization/formulation 6 wk + finishing/tests 6 wk; 3 x $6k CRO + $15k polymer/emulsion + ~$12k application and ~150 tests at ~$40-60/test

sale.gates: ECO PASSPORT/bluesign screen + ZDHC Gateway L3 ~6 mo; mill pad trials + brand wash/wear tests 1-2 yr; PPE re-cert to EN 13034 (o-xylene repellency) 6-12 mo
